facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list shows Libya with no date of signature, ratification/accession or deposit for the Malabo Convention; the list has 21 signatures and 20 deposits among 55 states.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

note: Libyan-Tunisian working group on mutual recognition of conformity certificates and quality marks (standards, not digital); no agreement or text named, so no fact.
Libya's signature of the UN Convention against Cybercrime is a United Nations text, class other; no African text named.
Arab League convention on IT offences (Libya signed 2010-12-21, no ratification recorded) is an Arab League text, class other; no African Union or regional-community text named.
No African shared digital legal text is mentioned; the Libyan arbitration law is only said to be inspired by the UNCITRAL Model Law.
